body:
Redline round 2

Reviewed only the fix diff from round 1 (b5c9f97..5327dfc).

The round 1 fixes do what their findings asked. The settings merge now keeps every value already in the file. I ran its conflicts expression on the new fixture, and it reports exactly the marketplace source and the disabled plugin. The config rerun changes only checker and checkerStallMs, and its sed pattern cannot touch the nested models.checker object. The new checks.json single-line and quote checks cover every field that lands in a comment or inside quotes. checks --dry-run writes nothing, and version now tells a newer file from an older one. The deferral wording for template fixes matches in point 11, the README and guard.md. Nothing here reads or writes data shared with a scheduled command or a queued job, and I found no new correctness bug.

No findings.
